sentence: Among Chinese listed companies, part of the AI--TFP link runs through improved control quality
passage: [Lin, Chang et al. (2026), abstract] "This research investigates the impact of AI adoption on total factor productivity (TFP) within Chinese A-share listed companies from 2007 to 2022." / "we identify a key transmission mechanism: the positive relationship between AI and TFP is partially channeled through enhanced internal control quality (ICQ)."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly confirms that enhanced internal control quality is a partial transmission mechanism for the positive relationship between AI and TFP in Chinese listed companies.
